title: The Advantages of Fresh Sketching for Ridge Regression
abstract: arXiv:2609.38565v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Over the past 25 years, sketching and sampling have become widely used tools for accelerating large-scale regression. In iterative randomized solvers, a basic design choice is whether to $\textit{reuse}$ the same sketch or draw $\textit{fresh}$ randomness at every step. For (under-constrained) iterative ridge regression with column sampling, whether fresh sketches offer provable advantages has remained open: $\textit{We show that they do.}$ Fresh sketching lets us analyze error only along the current residual solution, rather than uniformly over the entire Gram matrix. This directional view yields sharper convergence guarantees for leverage score and ridge leverage score sampling and, more importantly, leads to residual-aware sampling rules. translated_title: 岭回归中新鲜草图的优势
translated_abstract: 在过去的25年中，草图与采样已成为加速大规模回归问题的广泛使用的工具。在随机迭代求解器中，一个基本的设计选择是：究竟是复用同一个草图，还是在每一步都抽取全新的随机性。对于采用列采样的（欠约束）迭代岭回归而言，新鲜草图是否具有可证明的优势一直是一个悬而未决的问题：我们证明它们确实具有优势。新鲜草图使我们只需沿当前残差解的方向分析误差，而不必在整个Gram矩阵上一致地进行分析。这种方向性的视角为杠杆分数采样和岭杠杆分数采样带来了更紧致的收敛保证，更重要的是，它引出了感知残差的采样规则。通过最小化相关草图矩阵-向量乘积的方差，我们推导出了一个预言机分布及其实用的近似方法，其中包括混合采样分布……
tldr: 本文证明在采用列采样的迭代岭回归中，每步抽取新鲜草图具有可证明的优势——它使误差分析只需沿当前残差方向进行，从而得到更紧的收敛保证，并引出了基于残差感知的最优采样分布及其实用近似。
en_tdlr: This paper proves that fresh sketching offers provable advantages in iterative ridge regression with column sampling, enabling error analysis along the current residual direction, sharper convergence guarantees, and residual-aware near-optimal sampling rules.
